description:
PureVPN in ChatGPT helps you get secure and private internet access right where you’re already chatting.

Choose a VPN server in a supported country and protect your online activity— all through a simple, conversation-based interface.

Ask ChatGPT to help you choose the best server for streaming, public Wi-Fi security, remote work, or privacy. ChatGPT shows a button that opens the PureVPN app, so you can connect in just a few taps. The PureVPN app must be installed on your device.

defaultPrompt: I want to watch Netflix US with PureVPN
I'm at the airport, need to access my US work accounts securely
interface.longDescription:
PureVPN in ChatGPT helps you get secure and private internet access right where you’re already chatting.

Choose a VPN server in a supported country and protect your online activity— all through a simple, conversation-based interface.

Ask ChatGPT to help you choose the best server for streaming, public Wi-Fi security, remote work, or privacy. ChatGPT shows a button that opens the PureVPN app, so you can connect in just a few taps. The PureVPN app must be installed on your device.

positive.prompt: Use PureVPN to connect to a server in Germany
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a widget with a Connect Now button that opens the PureVPN app and connects to Germany.

positive.prompt: Use PureVPN to open Netflix US
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a widget with a Watch Now button for Netflix US.

positive.prompt: Use my VPN to watch BBC iPlayer
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a widget for BBC iPlayer with a UK server.
Shows an info card with PureVPN features and links to the website and download page.

positive.prompt: Using PureVPN, recommend something to watch
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends a show and shows a widget with a button to open the matching streaming service.

negative.description: General recommendation without PureVPN; ChatGPT should answer normally without calling a tool
Unsupported country; no tool call, the user is told to choose the server in the PureVPN app
negative.prompt: Connect PureVPN to a server in Russia
Use PureVPN to access the dark web

publication.release_notes: Removed promotional language from the listing, server instructions, and streaming tool. The streaming tool now runs only when the user asks to use PureVPN or a VPN, or invokes PureVPN. Added a support URL.
